thread:
alex.k: hey @people-ops — quick Q: I converted from contractor -> FTE effective 2025-04-01. My baby was born 2025-03-10. Can I add the newborn retroactive to the birth date? SSN is still pending. Also how are payroll deductions handled/prorated?

lina: congrats!! :tada: short answer: probably yes but need to confirm carrier rules and timing.

lina: conversion counts as a change in employment status. New hire/eligibility window starts 2025-04-01. There are two relevant windows: 30 days from birth (3/10) and 30 days from eligibility (4/01). We usually allow enrollment for births as a QLE if done within 30 days of birth. because the birth predates eligibility it's a little messy. I'll escalate to benefits ops to request a manual retro effective date.

emma: fyi — carriers differ on allowing retro coverage to a birth date when employment start is after birth. In practice: if you enroll within the administrative window we can request retro to 3/10, but carrier approval is required.

alex.k: ok thanks. For the SSN: can I enroll now as "SSN pending" and upload once it's issued?

lina: yes, enroll now and mark SSN pending in the portal. Required docs to upload: 
```
- birth certificate or hospital birth record
- FTE conversion offer letter / hire date proof
- eventual newborn SSN (upload when issued)
```

payroll-bot: payroll note: if retro effective 2025-03-10 is approved, payroll will backdate deductions and you will see a catch-up deduction on the next paycheck after the change is processed. Proration/tax withholding follows standard payroll rules; contact payroll@redwood for specific impact to net pay.

alex.k: I'd prefer retro coverage even if there's a catch-up. Please confirm carrier. Also timeline for when deductions show up?

lina: @emma @benefits-ops ping — can you confirm carrier acceptance & expected processing date? alex, DM me the birth cert when available and upload docs to Workday Benefits > Supporting Documents. I'll open a manual change ticket with carrier info.

benefits-ops: update (internal): carrier has tentatively approved retro to 2025-03-10 for newborn dependents when enrollment is submitted as a manual request with proof. We've submitted the manual retro enrollment today. Expect carrier confirmation within 3 business days. Payroll will process a catch-up on the 2025-05-15 paycheck (per payroll calendar).

alex.k: amazing, thank you all. I'll upload birth cert and SSN once I have it. Appreciate the help! :pray:
